title: The Columbian Exchange — Video POC
description: Two-scene proof of concept using Edge TTS, native titles, and a ten-second Meta-generated image animation.

narration.text: In 1492, sustained contact connected ecosystems that had developed separately for thousands of years. The consequences transformed societies on both sides of the Atlantic.
Ships carried crops, animals, pathogens, and people across the Atlantic, creating exchanges whose benefits and human costs were profoundly unequal.

animation.prompt: Tall ships ride broad rolling ocean swells, rising and settling gently; large sails billow under a steady wind; long pennants stream and flutter; layered clouds drift behind the masts; sea spray shimmers. Keep the camera static.
